g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the reward is one streak save before the reader chooses to play. The decline and ad-failure fields preserve normal reading and provide a path when the game cannot load or be confirmed.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is one in-app streak save, not money or a transferable or externally exchangeable benefit.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger uses app-open and story-completion events, not anything the user typed, said, or wrote.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The adds and removes-nothing-free fields introduce a streak without restricting the free news reading described in m3.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is under the Home header on s01, a content-safe screen, rather than inside a conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: As a product change, the streak save benefits the reader personally on Home and is tied to finishing stories, as observed in core flow f1.

c2_evidence.reason: s01 and core flow f1 support the Home-to-article-to-related-stories route, and the proposal says a streak was not seen rather than claiming the app has none. Daily readership is a user prediction; streak tracking is part of the proposed change.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward covers one missed day and is capped at one save per seven days; it does not grant lasting access to a paid benefit or take an advantage from others.

c5_moment.reason: The trigger and placement put the offer on Home when the reader returns after a missed day, rather than interrupting an article in progress.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The flow uses a short sponsored game triggered by detectable app events, and the ad-failure field withholds the save when play cannot be confirmed.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names the s01 Home header and ties its streak to reading stories through to the s32 related list.

other_concern: The model does not establish how many readers return daily or would value a streak.
